race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but ALWAYS HAPPY shaped well when runner-up at Southwell after an absence last time and can go one better with this first attempt beyond 1m also looking a plus. The consistent Borjina heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Arbaawy , Triple Force and Tropical Sands also need factoring in. ALWAYS HAPPY (IRE) BORJINA ARBAAWY
race.bettingForecast: Always Happy (4/1), Triple Force (5/1), Wadacre Icon (6/1), Borjina (7/1), Tropical Sands (7/1), Arbaawy (8/1), Per Contra (10/1), Morcar (10/1), Geo (14/1), Izzari (16/1), Caromb (25/1), High Point (33/1)
